name: A and M Jumbo Bags Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, A and M Jumbo Bags Ltd is in the business of Agro, agri, dairy, and milk products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AMJBL used to deal in jumbo bags, but has currently entered into a new
 business line focused on the trading of agricultural and dairy products. 
This includes undertaking activities such as trading, importing, exporting, 
improving, selling, and dealing in agro-based, agri-related, food items, and all categories of milk and dairy products.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 0.11% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 350 days.
